hero_p: Every stream — files, videos, torrents, browser downloads — flows into one fast, friendly place. Free and open source, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
hero_note: Free forever · no account · no ads · no tracking
name_h: Where many streams meet the sea
name_lead: In Bengali, mohona is the mouth of a river — the estuary where tributaries gather and flow out together. A download manager does the same thing.
name_b1: Many streams, one file. Mohona opens several connections to a server and joins the pieces, like tributaries into one river.
name_b2: One place for everything. Browser downloads, videos, torrents, cloud links and streams all arrive in the same list.
name_b3: Always moving on. A river never stops at an obstacle. Interrupted downloads resume, expired links renew, failed parts retry.
name_b4: Easy to say, anywhere. Four letters in Latin script, three in Bengali: mo-ho-na.
feat_h: Everything a classic download manager does — and more
feat_lead: Built from scratch in Rust for speed and safety, with a clean desktop app, a browser extension and a full command line.
f1_d: Splits each file over up to 32 connections, measures the server, and keeps only the connections that really help.
f2_d: Crash, power cut, dropped Wi-Fi: run it again and it continues. A download is never corrupted, and expired links are renewed from their page.
f3_d: Takes over downloads in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox, adds a button on videos, and saves files only your browser holds.
f4_t: Video and audio from the web
f4_d: YouTube, Vimeo and a thousand more sites. Choose quality, MP4/MKV/WebM/MOV/AVI — or sound only as MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC or WAV.
f5_d: Look inside first, download only the files you want, set speed limits, and decide how long to keep sharing.
f6_d: Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and GitHub share links become real downloads — Drive folders arrive as folders.
f7_d: List, filter and download the files a web page and the pages it links to offer, politely and with robots.txt respected.
f8_d: Limit how many run at once, set speed caps, run only at night, and shut down when everything is done.
f9_d: Sort finished files into folders by type, and write rules: when a download matches this, do that.
f10_d: Checksum verification, a virus scan after each download (Windows Defender or your own program), and private windows are never touched.
f11_d: HTTP(S), FTP/FTPS, SFTP, WebDAV, HLS and DASH streams, proxies and logins, multiple mirrors for one file.
f12_d: A tidy tray app, a scriptable mohona command, a local API with OpenAPI, and a web companion for your phone.
f13_d: Light, dark and nine colourful themes; English, বাংলা, हिन्दी, اردو, العربية, 中文, 日本語 and more.
f14_d: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer version and can install it for you with one click, after verifying its checksum.
why_h: Why choose it over another download manager?
r1_d: No trial, no licence key, no premium tier, no ads. The whole code is open under MIT or Apache-2.0.
r2_d: Open source means anyone can read what it does. There is no telemetry, and nothing leaves your computer except the downloads you ask for.
r3_d: Written in Rust: no memory bugs of the old kind, small and fast, with the engine separated from the interface.
r4_d: Files, video sites, torrents, cloud folders and streams in one list, with one set of limits and rules.
r5_d: A real command line and local API: script it, schedule it, put it on a server.
r6_d: 13 languages including right-to-left ones, and themes for every mood.
c_video: Video sites with quality and format choice
c_resume: Resumes after crash or expired link
why_fine: * Windows is the first-class, hand-tested platform; Linux and macOS builds are published with every release and are in beta. The comparison is general and from public information — features of other products change, so check them yourself.
th_h: Eleven colour themes — this page wears them too
th_lead: Pick one: the page, and the screenshot in the hero, switch to match. The app and the browser extension use the very same themes.
dl_lead: Installers for every system, straight from GitHub Releases. Each file comes with a checksum.
dl_note: The Windows installer carries the browser extension too: Settings → Browsers opens its folder. Mohona also checks GitHub for newer versions and can install them for you.
ext_load: Chrome / Edge / Brave — load from the installer folder
s1_d: Run the installer. It sets up the app, the tray icon and the browser connection.
s2_d: Settings → Browsers → open the extension folder, then Load unpacked in your browser (or use the store when it is live).
s3_d: Click any download link, press the button on a video, or paste addresses into + Add.
s4_d: Pick a theme and language, set categories, queues and limits. Or use the mohona command.
ft_tag: an estuary for your downloads. MIT or Apache-2.0.
meta_title: Mohona — the free, open-source download manager
meta_desc: Mohona is a free, open-source download manager: many connections per file, resume after anything, browser extension, video and audio from YouTube and more, torrents, queues, 13 languages and 11 themes.
cap1: Your list: progress, speed and time left, with categories on the left.
cap2: Paste web addresses, magnet links, video pages or a Google Drive folder.
cap3: Find every file a site offers and pick what to download.
cap4: Run lists with limits on how many go at once.
cap5: Download at night or on weekdays only, and shut down when done.
cap6: Control sharing and set separate torrent speed limits.
cap7: The popup: add links, see progress, and choose quality and format for a video.
cap8: The mohona command: get, queue, grab, video-format, scan and more.
cap9: Light, dark and nine other themes, all consistent.
